victory.description:
Fire and Smoke, peal of swords and whistle of arrows...
Many years have passed since those glorious battles.
Life is more or less peaceful now. All clans and groups licked their wounds.
But what is a life without fighting!?
victory.name: In the Wake of Gods
victory.scenarioDescription:
The journey here was long.
Gorynych nagged you the entire time in a tiresome voice:
"How would you make it without me!?"
Your blind belief Gorynych's divine destiny is starting to fade.
All the while, your new companion, Monk, kept his silence.
You are unsure that you choose the right way.

lines:
I am not sure that this is enough,
but I hope that you come up to a good way.
And to watch over you I would like to follow you.
dialogs.title: Game message

lines:
Hey, hey!
Do not even think about going without me!
Wait...I am back...with my friend!
dialogs.title: Game message

lines:
{Followers}

A group of Monk with a desire for greater glory wish to join you. Do you accept?
dialogs.title: Game message

lines: Congratulations! You have completed your quest to kill the fearsome beast, and can claim victory!
dialogs.title: Game message

lines:
Well, well, well.
You are not a knight... well... the wrong knight.
I am very very disappointed.
You have destroyed all of my hopes!
I should think it over.
I will think a long time...
... very, very long time...
...looooooooong time...
dialogs.title: Game message

lines:
That's it.
I'm leaving you.
Find your way yourself.
But mark my word, get back to those fields.
...
Kitty-kitty-kitty!
Puss-puss!
Come with me my lovely horse.
dialogs.title: Game message
